Sep 22, 2026, 5:01 AM ET Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. Limited Partnership Units (BIP) Stock , BIP.UN:CA Stock , BIPH , BIPC Stock , BIPC:CA Stock , BIP.PR.A Stock , BIP.PR.B Stock , BIPJ BIP.PR.F:CA , BRIPF 18 Comments

Summary Brookfield Infrastructure Partners maintains a Buy rating, supported by resilient FFO growth, strong yield, and robust capital deployment despite macro headwinds. BIP reported 10% YoY FFO per unit growth, a 15% ROIC, and advanced its AI infrastructure strategy, including a major DOE-backed data center project. The planned structural simplification will eliminate K-1 filings, potentially broadening institutional interest and streamlining the equity and preferreds landscape. Valuation remains attractive, with intrinsic value estimated above current levels, though macro risks and higher rates could pressure multiples and growth.

In my previous analysis of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. ( BIP ), I reiterated its Buy rating, arguing that its valuation remained attractive while it offered a solid yield amid the ongoing macro headwinds.

I've been researching companies in-depth for over a decade, from commodities like oil, natural gas, gold and copper to tech like Google or Nokia and many emerging market stocks, which I believe could help me provide useful content for readers. After writing my own blog for about 3 years, I decided to switch to a value investing-focused YouTube channel, where I researched hundreds of different companies so far. I would say my favorite type of company to cover are metals and mining stocks, but I am comfortable with several other industries, such as consumer discretionary/staples, REITs and utilities.
